title: Germany – Asbestos-removal work – Abbruch- und Rückbauarbeiten
description: Gegenstand der Ausschreibung sind Schadstoffsanierungsarbeiten im Altbau des Deutschen Technikmuseums Berlin im Zuge der Erneuerung der technischen Gebäudeausrüstung. Die Leistungen umfassen die Einrichtung und den Betrieb der Baustelle einschließlich Schwarzbereichen, Personen- und Materialschleusen, Unterdruckhaltungen, Abschottungen, Schutzmaßnahmen sowie erforderlicher Gerüstkonstruktionen für Arbeiten in Installationsschächten und Höhenbereichen. Bestandteil der Leistung sind die Schadstoffsanierung und der Rückbau asbesthaltiger Baustoffe und Bauteile, insbesondere Asbestzementrohre, Brandschutzklappen, Fliesenkleber, Wand- und Deckenbeschichtungen, Brandschutztüren, Rohrflanschdichtungen sowie weiterer asbesthaltiger Bauprodukte. Weiterhin sind KMF-haltige Rohrisolierungen, Dämmstoffe an Lüftungsanlagen, Dämmungen oberhalb von Abhangdecken und in Trockenbaukonstruktionen sowie Hochtemperaturwollen fachgerecht auszubauen. Darüber hinaus sind PCB-haltige Kondensatoren und quecksilberhaltige Leuchtstoffröhren zu demontieren. Die Leistungen beinhalten außerdem Entkernungs- und Abbrucharbeiten, die Herstellung von Schachtöffnungen, die Demontage von Lüftungszentralen, Luftkanälen, Rohrleitungen und sonstigen haustechnischen Anlagenbestandteilen sowie die erforderliche Dekontamination, Grob- und Feinreinigung sämtlicher Sanierungsbereiche einschließlich der Installationsschächte. Ergänzend sind sanierungsbegleitende Messungen, die getrennte Erfassung, Verpackung, innerbetriebliche Logistik, der Transport sowie die ordnungsgemäße Entsorgung gefährlicher und nicht gefährlicher Abfälle einschließlich vollständiger Nachweisführung und Entsorgungsdokumentation auszuführen. Die Arbeiten erfolgen abschnitts- und etagenweise unter laufendem Museumsbetrieb und unter Einhaltung der einschlägigen Anforderungen des Gefahrstoff-, Arbeits- und Umweltschutzrechts.

title: Ertüchtigung KA Kamp-Bornhofen - Los 02
description: Die Kläranlage Kamp-Bornhofen wird von den Verbandsgemeindewerken Loreley betrieben und ist rund 30 Jahre alt. Sie wurde ursprünglich für ca. 1.700 Einwohnerwerte (EW) konzipiert und in Kompaktbauweise innerhalb einer Betriebshalle errichtet. Auf Grundlage aktueller Betriebsdatenauswertungen (2018-2022) liegt die tatsächliche Anschlussgröße bereits bei 2.163 EW. Unter Berücksichtigung geplanter Wohnbau- und Gewerbeentwicklungen wird künftig von einer Belastung von 2.274 EW ausgegangen. Für eine zukunftssichere Auslegung wurde die neue Anlage daher auf 2.700 EW bemessen. Die bestehende Anlage hat ihre hydraulische und stoffliche Leistungsgrenze erreicht. Gleichzeitig wurden seitens der Genehmigungsbehörde verschärfte Einleitbedingungen angekündigt. Insbesondere ist eine Reduzierung des Phosphor-Grenzwertes von derzeit 6 mg/l auf künftig 2 mg/l vorgesehen. Ohne eine grundlegende Ertüchtigung kann die dauerhafte Einhaltung der wasserrechtlichen Anforderungen sowie die weitere Siedlungsentwicklung im Einzugsgebiet nicht gewährleistet werden. Ziel des Vorhabens ist daher die nachhaltige Erweiterung und Modernisierung der Kläranlage zur Sicherstellung der zukünftigen Ausbaugröße, zur Einhaltung der verschärften Einleitwerte sowie zur dauerhaften Verbesserung des Gewässerschutzes im Einzugsgebiet des Rheins. Im Rahmen einer Machbarkeitsstudie wurden mehrere technische Varianten untersucht. Als Vorzugsvariante wurde ein konventionelles Belebtschlammverfahren mit horizontal durchströmter Nachklärung (Variante 1.2) ermittelt. Die geplanten Maßnahmen umfassen insbesondere: - Neubau einer Rechen-Walzensandfang-Kompaktanlage - Neubau eines Belebungsbeckens (ca. 965 m³) - Neubau eines horizontal durchströmten Nachklärbeckens (68 m² Oberfläche) - Neubau eines Schlammstapelbehälters (ca. 310 m³) - Neubau eines Ablaufmessbauwerks - Neubau eines Betriebsgebäudes für Pumpen, Gebläse und Elektrotechnik. (Das Gebäude dient im vorliegenden Fall nicht als klassischer Hochbau, sondern fungiert im Wesentlichen rein als bauliche und funktionale Hülle für die aufzunehmende Maschinentechnik. Gebäudegeometrie und bauphysikalischen Anforderungen werden von den verfahrenstechnischen Parametern der Maschinentechnik vorgegeben.) Die Bemessung erfolgt gemäß DWA-A 131. Die zukünftigen Ablaufwerte erfüllen die verschärften Anforderungen an CSB, BSB5, Stickstoff und insbesondere Phosphor (? 2 mg/l). Besondere Herausforderungen des Projektes sind die Lage im festgesetzten Überschwemmungsgebiet des Rheins, die beengten Grundstücksverhältnisse zwischen Bahnlinie und Bundesstraße sowie die Notwendigkeit der Umsetzung im laufenden Betrieb. Die Baumaßnahme wird daher in mehreren Bauabschnitten realisiert, um die Abwasserreinigung während der gesamten Bauzeit sicherzustellen. Die Maßnahme leistet einen wesentlichen Beitrag zum Gewässerschutz, insbesondere zur Reduzierung der Nährstoffeinträge in den Rhein, und sichert zugleich die kommunale Daseinsvorsorge sowie die weitere städtebauliche Entwicklung der Ortsgemeinde Kamp-Bornhofen.

title: Ireland – IT services: consulting, software development, Internet and support – 0055 - The Provision of Security Operations Centre (SOC) and Security Information and Event Management (SIEM) Services
description: An Post requires a suitably qualified Security Partner to deliver a managed Security Operations Centre (SOC) and Security Information and Event Management (SIEM) service across its technology estate. The successful Supplier will be responsible for providing a resilient, secure, and professionally managed cybersecurity capability that supports continuous security monitoring, threat detection, incident analysis, alert triage, incident response, escalation management, compliance assurance, service reporting, and ongoing service improvement. The Supplier will work collaboratively with An Post personnel and relevant third-party providers to ensure comprehensive monitoring coverage, effective management of security incidents, and alignment with An Post's security, resilience, governance, and regulatory requirements. The service will include the provision, operation, management, and continuous enhancement of security monitoring and incident management capabilities, including support for Microsoft Sentinel as An Post's current SIEM platform. The Supplier must also be capable of supporting alternative SIEM technologies should An Post's security architecture evolve during the contract term. In addition, the Supplier must be able to monitor and manage security event sources across both Microsoft and non-Microsoft technologies, including platforms that do not natively integrate with Microsoft Sentinel. The scope of the service is expected to include, but is not limited to, managed cybersecurity operations, threat detection and analysis, incident management and response, security platform support, threat intelligence, governance and reporting, and the provision of suitably qualified cybersecurity personnel to support service delivery.

title: Ireland – Networks – 9719 IM GSM-R Call Monitoring Solution
description: Iarnród Éireann (IÉ) currently operates and maintains a national GSM-R mobile network which provides driver to CTC communications via on-board GSM-R cab-mobile equipment provided by Siemens Mobility. Currently, GSM-R is in operation on the DART network, with national rollout expected to occur in 2026 on the rest of IE’s fleets. As part of the overall maintenance of the GSM-R mobile network, IÉ carry out monitoring and drive- testing which at present requires IÉ Telecoms personnel to perform this task. The task requires staff to travel onboard IÉ Trainsets with monitoring equipment, which can be both onerous and time consuming. IÉ require the provision of an automated drive-testing and RF monitoring solution that will negate the requirement for staff to travel. To achieve this requirement, it is therefore required to provide a GSM-R Modem and hardware (option)/software/firmware capable of interfacing with the modem and providing the end-user (IE) with a HTTP REST API. This can be integrated with the existing IÉ hosted servers which run a combination of NodeJS applications, InfluxDB and Grafana for recording and visualization of the obtained data or hosted on a supplier provided cloud-based solution that is accessible by IÉ. Further specific details will be provided to the companies who are pre-qualified to the ITT stage. (This tender was previously issued under Resource ID 7911685, which was cancelled).

title: The Provision of Housing Support Services for Single People and Childless Couples who are Homeless and may have Complex Needs
description: The Service to be provided by the Provider is the provision of a Housing Support Service, primarily for single people or childless couples who are homeless and may have complex needs, residing in supported, interim accommodation. The Provider will also provide or make partnering arrangements with another organisation to provide a Housing Management Service for the accommodation at specific Premises and where applicable will enter into such associated lease arrangements with the owner landlord of the Premises as may be necessary for this purpose. The Housing Management Service does not form part of this Contract but is required to be delivered in conjunction with the Service. Tenderers can determine whether they will provide this service, or whether they will contract with another organisation to provide this service. How this related Housing Management Service is provided will directly impact upon Council budgets for the provision of homeless services and the amount of government funding available to support these services. The Council looks to maximise the monies available to better assist more Service Users. The specific Premises to support the Housing Support Service must be Specified Accommodation as defined by Law. The manner in which the Provider makes formal arrangements for the lease of the Premises will directly impact upon the Council and may result in higher costs to the Council. In respect of any subsidy shortfall however, while the Council cannot mandate how a Provider arranges their commercial business, the Council seeks to maximise the funds available to it to provide appropriate services and to allow maximum recovery, by the Council from the UK Government, of Housing Benefit paid for Service Users assessed as needing Housing Support Services. To assist the Council to maximise recovery of funds Tenderers would require to arrange that they are either (1) a Housing Association, a relevant body in accordance with Regulation 75H of the Housing Benefit Regulations 2006 as amended and enter into the occupancy arrangement (lease between themselves and the Service Users) or alternatively (2) contract with a third party who is a Housing Association and they would enter into lease arrangements with the Service Users and make separate contractual arrangements directly with the Tenderer. Tenderers should be aware that Charities are also relevant bodies for the purpose of the Housing Benefit Regulations 2006, however arrangements made with a Charity would require to be referred to the Rent Officer who would set the amount recoverable, whereas Housing Association arrangements are not subject to this form of review which allows for greater recovery by the Council.

title: Germany – Switchgear – Lieferung einer mobilen Schaltanlage (Leistungsschalteranlagen gasisoliert und metallgekapselt, Sammelschiene 1250 A, 20 kA)
description: Die EAM Netz GmbH (nachfolgend „ENM“) ist ein mittelständischer Strom- und Gasverteilnetzbetreiber. Das ENM-Netzgebiet umfasst eine geografische Fläche von mehr als 11.500 Quadratkilometern und erstreckt sich über weite Teile Hessens sowie über Südniedersachsen, Teile von Ostwestfalen, Westthüringen und seit April 2014 auch über Teile des Landkreises Altenkirchen in Rheinland-Pfalz. ENM versteht sich als Unternehmen mit regionalem Bezug. Die ENM beabsichtig den Kauf einer mobilen Schaltanlage gem. der beigefügten technischen Spezifikation (Anforderung). Lieferung zum frühestmöglichen Zeitpunkt nach Vergabe. Mindestanforderungen: Leistungsbeschreibung Mobile Schaltanlage (Leistungsschalteranlagen gasisoliert und metallgekapselt, Sammelschiene 1250 A, 20 kA): Ausgeschrieben wird eine voll funktionstüchtige Anlage inklusive aller Nebengewerke. Alle im Verfahren nicht genannten Leistungen, die für die Funktionstüchtigkeit notwendig machen, sind Bestandteil und Umfang der Ausschreibung. Der bauliche Teil der mobilen Schaltanlage erfolgt als Containerbauweise. Der Container muss, aus Gründen der Austauschbarkeit bezüglich Abmessungen und Anschlussmöglichkeiten, kompatibel zu den bei EAM Netz vorhandenen mobilen Schaltanlagen sein. Außenabmessungen des Containers LxBxH:7,00x2,54x2,98m und die beigefügten Konstruktionszeichnungen sind zu beachten. 8 Stück MS-Schaltfelder müssen im Container eingebaut werden können. Die gesamte Sekundäranlage inklusive aller Verdrahtungsarbeiten muss erstellt werden. Der Anschluss der Gebäudeinstallation muss hergestellt werden. Im Einzelnen sind anzubieten: • Lieferung und Montage eines 2-Achs-Anhänger in Sonderausführung mit Container oder vergleichbar • Lieferung und Montage einer gasisolierten 24 kV-Mittelspannungsschaltanlage gemäß beiliegender techn. Spezifikation und Übersichtsschaltbild. • Lieferung und Montage der Erdungsanlage • Lieferung und Montage von Grundrahmen und Stahlbaukonstruktion mit zugehöriger Statik • Lieferung und Montage des Doppelbodens • Erstellen einer Druckberechnung für die Nennwerte der Schaltanlage. • Lieferung und Montage eines Druckentlastungssystems falls erforderlich • Erstellen der Rauchschottung • Montage und anschließen aller beigestellten Sekundärschränke inklusive aller Leitungen • Lieferung und Montage der Elektroinstallation inklusive Installationsschrank Die Vergabestelle behält sich vor, den Zuschlag auf Grundlage der Erstangebote gemäß § 15 Abs. 4 SektVO zu erteilen. Sofern hiervon kein Gebrauch gemacht wird, können mit den Bietern Verhandlungen über die preislichen, qualitativen, technischen sowie gegebenenfalls rechtlichen Inhalte ihrer Angebote geführt werden. Im Anschluss erhalten die Bieter Gelegenheit zur Überarbeitung ihrer Angebote. Nach Auswertung der überarbeiteten Angebote kann der Auftraggeber die Anzahl der zur weiteren Verhandlung zugelassenen Bieter reduzieren.

title: The Provision of Housing Support Services for Single People and Childless Couples who are Homeless and may have Complex Needs
description: The Service to be provided by the Provider is the provision of a Housing Support Service, primarily for single people or childless couples who are homeless and may have complex needs, residing in supported, interim accommodation. The Provider will also provide or make partnering arrangements with another organisation to provide a Housing Management Service for the accommodation at specific Premises and where applicable will enter into such associated lease arrangements with the owner landlord of the Premises as may be necessary for this purpose. The Housing Management Service does not form part of this Contract but is required to be delivered in conjunction with the Service. Tenderers can determine whether they will provide this service, or whether they will contract with another organisation to provide this service. How this related Housing Management Service is provided will directly impact upon Council budgets for the provision of homeless services and the amount of government funding available to support these services. The Council looks to maximise the monies available to better assist more Service Users. The specific Premises to support the Housing Support Service must be Specified Accommodation as defined by Law. The manner in which the Provider makes formal arrangements for the lease of the Premises will directly impact upon the Council and may result in higher costs to the Council. In respect of any subsidy shortfall however, while the Council cannot mandate how a Provider arranges their commercial business, the Council seeks to maximise the funds available to it to provide appropriate services and to allow maximum recovery, by the Council from the UK Government, of Housing Benefit paid for Service Users assessed as needing Housing Support Services. To assist the Council to maximise recovery of funds Tenderers would require to arrange that they are either (1) a Housing Association, a relevant body in accordance with Regulation 75H of the Housing Benefit Regulations 2006 as amended and enter into the occupancy arrangement (lease between themselves and the Service Users) or alternatively (2) contract with a third party who is a Housing Association and they would enter into lease arrangements with the Service Users and make separate contractual arrangements directly with the Tenderer. Tenderers should be aware that Charities are also relevant bodies for the purpose of the Housing Benefit Regulations 2006, however arrangements made with a Charity would require to be referred to the Rent Officer who would set the amount recoverable, whereas Housing Association arrangements are not subject to this form of review which allows for greater recovery by the Council.

title: Dynaaminen hankintajärjestelmä: Terveydenhuollon hoito- ja yleistarvikkeet
description: Tällä ilmoituksella perustetaan dynaaminen hankintajärjestelmä. Hankinnan kohteena dynaamisen hankintajärjestelmän (jäljempänä DPS) sisällä olevat perusterveydenhuollossa ja erikoissairaanhoidossa käytettävät hoito-, hygienia- ja yleistarvikkeet, ja tarvittaessa niihin liittyvät lisäpalvelut. HUS pyrkii tällä dynaamisella hankintajärjestelmällä hankkimaan sellaisia perusterveydenhuollon ja erikoissairaanhoidon hoito-, hygienia- ja yleistarvikkeita, joita ei ole huomioitu tällä hetkellä voimassa olevissa hankintasopimuksissa tai joiden tarve on tullut yllättäen muuttuneista tarpeista tai hoitokäytänteistä johtuen. HUS varaa oikeuden järjestää perusterveydenhuollon ja erikoissairaanhoidon hoito-, hygienia- ja yleistarvikkeiden kilpailutuksia tarvittaessa myös tämän dynaamisen hankintajärjestelmän ulkopuolella. Hankittavat nimikkeet ja nimikekokonaisuudet määritellään tarkemmin dynaamisen hankintajärjestelmän sisäisessä kilpailutuksessa. Dynaamisen hankintajärjestelmän kesto on 48 kuukautta. Pyydämme osallistumishakemuksia perusterveydenhuollossa ja erikoissairaanhoidossa käytettävien hoito-, hygienia- ja yleistarvikkeiden, ja tarvittaessa niihin liittyvien lisäpalveluiden dynaamiseen hankintajärjestelmään (DPS). Hankinnan kohteena dynaamisen hankintajärjestelmän (jäljempänä DPS) sisällä ovat perusterveydenhuollossa ja erikoissairaanhoidossa käytettävät hoito-, hygienia- ja yleistarvikkeet ja tarvittaessa niihin liittyvät lisäpalvelut. Hankittavat nimikkeet ja nimikekokonaisuudet määritellään tarkemmin kussakin dynaamisen hankintajärjestelmän sisäisessä kilpailutuksessa. HUSin tavoitteena on hankkia joustavalla ja yksinkertaisella menettelyllä laadukkaita perusterveydenhuollossa ja erikoissairaanhoidossa käytettäviä hoito-, hygienia- ja yleistarvikkeita tukemaan HUSin ja sen kumppanien perusterveydenhuoltoa ja erikoissairaanhoitoa. Dynaamiseen hankintajärjestelmään voi jättää osallistumishakemuksia koko sen keston ajan. DPS:ään voi hakea tarjoajaksi, jos täyttää soveltuvuusvaatimukset, jotka on ilmoitettu ESPD-lomakkeessa sekä Tarjouspyynnön kohdissa "Muut ehdot" ja "Hankinnan kohteen kriteerit". DPS:ään otetaan mukaan kaikki soveltuvuusvaatimukset täyttävät ehdokkaat. Varsinaiset hankinnat tehdään dynaamisen hankintajärjestelmän sisäisillä kilpailutuksilla, joissa kuvataan ja täsmennetään hankinnan kohde.

title: Psykososiaalisten menetelmäkoulutusten hankinta
description: Tuomi Logistiikka Oy pyytää Pirkanmaan hyvinvointialueen toimeksiannosta tarjouksia tilaajan henkilökunnalle tarjottavista psykososiaalisista menetelmäkoulutuskokonaisuuksista tämän tarjouspyynnön ja sen liitteiden mukaisesti. Hankintasopimuksen kohteena ovat Pirkanmaan hyvinvointialueen henkilöstölle järjestettävät psykiatristen häiriöiden psykososiaaliset menetelmäkoulutukset. Koulutukset toteutetaan ammattilaisten työtehtäviä tukevina lyhyt- tai pidempikestoisina koulutuskokonaisuuksina. Menetelmäkoulutusten sisältöön kuuluvat: - Menetelmän teoreettisten periaatteiden ja hoitomallin opetus - Menetelmän rakenteen, vaiheiden ja keskeisten työkalujen läpikäynti - Käytännön harjoitteet, case-esimerkit ja soveltamistavat - Luento-opiskeluun liittyvä koulutusmateriaali: Koulutusmateriaalit ja menetelmään liittyvä opetusmateriaali tulee olla pääosin suomenkielistä. Jos ei suomenkielistä materiaalia ole saatavilla, voi materiaali olla myös englanninkielistä Hankinta on jaettu osa-alueisiin seuraavasti: Osa-alue 1. DKT– Dialektinen käyttäytymisterapia Osa-alue 2. CBASP – Cognitive Behavior Analysis system of Psychotherapy Osa-alue 3. CRT – Cognitive Remediation Therapy Osa-alue 4. SCIT – Social Cognition and Interaction Training Osa-alue 5. START – The Short- Term Assesment of Risk and Treatability Osa-alue 6. KKT – Kognitiivinen käyttäytymisterapia -perusteet Osa-alue 7. Scema Therapy – Skeematerapia Osa-alue 8. MBT – Mentalisation Based Therapy Osa-alue 9. CBT-I, Cognitive Behavioural Therapy for Insomnia Osa-alue 10. HOT, hyväksymis- ja omistautumisterapia Osa-alue 11. BA – Käyttäytymisen aktivaatio Osa-alueiden 1-6 ja 9-11 koulutuskokonaisuudet koostuvat koulutuspäivistä. Osa-alueiden 7 ja 8 koulutuskokonaisuudet koostuvat koulutuspäivistä ja ryhmämuotoisesta työnohjauksesta. Lähikoulutukset ja -tapaamiset toteutetaan tilaajan hallinnoimissa tiloissa tai tilaajan osoittamissa tiloissa. Kaikki tarjouspyynnön mukaiset, soveltuvuusvaatimukset ja palvelua koskevat ehdottomat vähimmäisvaatimukset täyttävät tarjoajat valitaan palveluntuottajiksi. Palveluntuottajista muodostetaan sijajärjestys (=palveluntuottajarekisteri) kokonaistaloudellisesti edullisimman tarjouksen perusteella. Tarjousvertailu ja sijajärjestys muodostetaan osa-alueittain halvimman hinnan perusteella. Sopimuskausi alkaa 1.1.2027 ja on voimassa toistaiseksi. Hankinnan ennakoitu arvo on laskettu koko hankintakokonaisuuden osalta laskennallisen neljän (4) vuoden ajalta perustuen tilaajan arvioimiin asiakasmääriin. Hankintasopimuksen perusteella tehtävien tilausten määrät vaihtelevat tilaajan tarpeen mukaan, eikä hankintasopimus sisällä määrä- tai vähimmäisostovelvoitetta. Hankinnan kohde ja vähimmäisvaatimukset on kuvattu tarjouspyynnössä ja tarjouspyynnön liitteissä. Tarjoaja voi jättää tarjouksen yhteen tai useampaan osa-alueeseen. Rinnakkaisia tarjouksia ei hyväksytä., Osa-alue 1. DKT – Dialektinen käyttäytymisterapia Koulutuskokonaisuus edustaa kognitiivisen käyttäytymisterapian koulutuskokonaisuutta, DKT – Dialektinen käyttäytymisterapia (tunne-elämän epävakauden ja itsetuhoisuuden hoitoon kohdennettu taitopainotteinen terapia). Koulutuskokonaisuus: kuusi (6) lähikoulutuspäivää Yhden koulutuspäivän kesto: 7,39 tuntia sisältäen lounas- ja kahvitauot Ryhmän koko: korkeintaan 24 osallistujaa Sopimuskausi alkaa 1.1.2027 ja on voimassa toistaiseksi., Osa-alue 2. CBASP – Cognitive Behavior Analysis system of Psychotherapy Koulutuskokonaisuus edustaa kognitiivisen käyttäytymisterapian koulutuskokonaisuutta CBASP – Kognitiivinen psykoterapia, ryhmähoitomalli (Cognitive Behavioral Analysis System of Psychotherapy). Koulutuskokonaisuus: kuusi (6) lähikoulutuspäivää Yhden koulutuspäivän kesto: 7,39 tuntia sisältäen lounas- ja kahvitauot Ryhmän koko: korkeintaan 24 osallistujaa Sopimuskausi alkaa 1.1.2027 ja on voimassa toistaiseksi., Osa-alue 3. CRT – Cognitive Remediation Therapy Psykoosipotilaiden vaihe- tai yksilöspesifiset kuntoutusmenetelmät, neurokognitiivinen remediaatio): Koulutuskokonaisuus edustaa psykoosipotilaiden vaihe- tai yksilöspesifistä kuntoutusmenetelmää: neurokognitiivinen remediaatio, esim. CRT, yksilö tai ryhmä. Koulutuskokonaisuus: kolme (3) lähikoulutuspäivää Yhden koulutuspäivän kesto: 7,39 tuntia sisältäen lounas- ja kahvitauot Ryhmän koko: korkeintaan 24 osallistujaa Sopimuskausi alkaa 1.1.2027 ja on voimassa toistaiseksi., Osa-alue 4. SCIT, yksilö tai ryhmä. title: Tuetun asumisen palvelut

Tuettu asuminen on sosiaalihuoltolain (1301/2014) 21a§:n mukaista yksilökohtaista sosiaaliohjauksellista tukea henkilölle, joka erityisestä syystä tarvitsee hyvinvointialueen apua tai tukea itsenäiseen asumiseen tai siihen siirtymiseen. Tuetun asumisen palvelu on suunnattu täysi-ikäisille Pirkanmaan hyvinvointialueen järjestämisvelvollisuuden piiriin kuuluville asiakkaille. Tuki kohdistuu itsenäisen elämän mahdollistamiseen, osallistumisen vahvistamiseen ja turvalliseen arkeen, jossa asiakkaan omat valinnat ja itsemääräämisoikeus toteutuvat. Tuetun asumisen palvelu toteutetaan asiakkaan omassa kodissa tai Palveluntuottajan vuokraamassa asunnossa. Hankittava palvelu koostuu seuraavista tukijaksoista: - Tukijakso 1A: ohjaus- ja tukityöskentely enintään 60 tuntia enintään 6 kuukauden aikajaksolla. - Tukijakso 1B: ohjaus- ja tukityöskentely enintään 6 tuntia kuukaudessa enintään 12 kuukauden ajan. - Tukijakso 1C: ohjaus- ja tukityöskentely yksilöllisen päätöksen mukaisesti (noin 10-12 tuntia kuukaudessa). Lempäälä, Vesilahti, Valkeakoski, Akaa, Urjala 6. Virrat, Ruovesi, Parkano, Kihniö 7. Optio: Mänttä-Vilppula, Juupajoki Sopimuskausi alkaa 1.1.2027 ja on voimassa toistaiseksi. Hankinnan ennakoitu arvioitu arvo on noin 6 miljoonaa euroa vuodessa. Laskennallinen neljän vuoden hankinnan arvo on tällöin arviolta 24 milj. euroa. Tilaajalla on oikeus ottaa optio käyttöön sopimuskauden aikana ilmoittamalla siitä kirjallisesti Palveluntuottajalle. Mikäli optio otetaan käyttöön, palvelu tulee aloittaa sopimuksen mukaan, kuitenkin viimeistään kolmen kuukauden kuluessa ilmoituksesta. Tilaaja ei sitoudu ottamaan optiota käyttöön eikä option käyttämättä jättäminen oikeuta toimittajaa korvaukseen. Tarjoaja voi tulla valituksi optioalueen palveluntuottajaksi ainoastaan jättämällä tarjouksen tässä tarjouskilpailussa. Dynaamiseen hankintajärjestelmään voi jättää osallistumishakemuksia koko sen keston ajan. DPS:ään otetaan mukaan kaikki soveltuvuusvaatimukset täyttävät ehdokkaat. Varsinaiset hankinnat tehdään dynaamisen hankintajärjestelmän sisäisillä kilpailutuksilla, joissa kuvataan ja täsmennetään hankinnan kohde.

Requirement Details Tendering Procedure: Selective Tendering This requirement is open only to those TBIPS Supply Arrangement Holders who qualified under Tier 1 for services in the National Capital Region for the following categories: • Category A.1. Application/Software Architect Level 3 • Category I.2. Database Administrator Level 3 • Category I.6. Network Analyst Level 3 • Category I.11. Technology Architect Level 3 The following SA Holders have been invited to submit a proposal: • Accenture Inc. • ADRM Technology Consulting Group Corp. • BoonBridge Corporation • CDW Canada Corp. • CGI Information Systems and Management Consultants Inc. • Cofomo Inc. • Deloitte Inc. • Donna Cona Inc., IBM Canada Limited Joint Venture • Flex Tech Services Inc • Primex Project Management Limited • Prologic Systems Ltd., and Maplesoft Consulting Inc. in JV • Skyfly Solutions Inc., iFathom Corp., EPI-Use Now Inc. in Joint Venture • Spaghetti Logic Inc. • TRM Technologies Inc. • Xelerance Corporation Description of Work: The objective of this requirement is to augment knowledge within the Department of Justice Canada’s (JUS) Cloud team to gather expertise and meet project requirements and specific AI initiatives. The required professional services will support the delivery of key infrastructure components, networking fixes and improvements as well as high visibility projects such as Otto , Artificial Intelligence and the Lakehouse. The Cloud Engineer will implement, configure, automate, and support cloud infrastructure, platform services, and cloud-native solutions in accordance with Government of Canada Cloud Guardrails, departmental standards, enterprise architecture principles, and security controls. The Cloud Engineer will support the deployment, integration, modernization, and operational management of Microsoft Azure services, enterprise applications, AI-enabled solutions, and hybrid cloud environments. The Cloud Engineer will collaborate with the Cloud Centre of Expertise (CCoE), Shared Services Canada (SSC), Security Operations, infrastructure teams, application teams, and project stakeholders to deploy, configure, monitor, troubleshoot, automate, and document cloud services, platform components, application hosting environments, identity services, storage, networking, and operational processes while supporting continuous improvement, operational excellence, and knowledge transfer. The Cloud Architect will design, document, and provide technical leadership for the Department's cloud architecture, ensuring compliance with Government of Canada Cloud Guardrails, departmental standards, security controls, and enterprise architecture principles. The Cloud Architect will support cloud infrastructure, cloud-native applications, application modernization initiatives, Azure platform services, AI-enabled solutions, and hybrid architectures. Responsibilities include the design of governance models, subscription hierarchies, landing zones, security architecture, integration patterns, DevSecOps practices, application hosting models, and reference architectures to support enterprise cloud adoption and integration with on-premises and cloud-based services. The Network Specialist will design, implement, document, and support cloud and hybrid networking solutions that provide secure, resilient, and high-performing connectivity between cloud, on-premises, partner, and externally hosted environments. The specialist will support enterprise cloud platforms, cloud-native applications, application modernization initiatives, AI-enabled solutions, and hybrid architectures by designing and implementing networking services, secure integration patterns, and connectivity solutions. The Network Specialist will collaborate with Shared Services Canada (SSC), internal Security Operations, infrastructure teams, application teams, and project stakeholders to design, implement, validate, and document network connectivity, firewall configurations, DNS services, certificate management, identity integration, private connectivity, and network security controls in accordance with Government of Canada standards and departmental policies. The Database Administrator will design, implement, maintain, and optimize database platforms across on-premises and Azure environments, ensuring the availability, performance, security, and recoverability of business-critical systems. The Database Administrator will implement and support backup, restore, high availability, disaster recovery, monitoring, and security controls, while providing technical advice and documentation related to database migrations, cloud integration, and operational best practices in coordination with application teams, Shared Services Canada (SSC), and internal security stakeholders. Bidders must submit a bid for all resource categories. Security Requirement: All Contractor personnel must hold at a minimum, a Personnel security screening level of Reliability. Privileged users require a Personnel Security screening level of Secret. Unscreened personnel are prohibited from performing services under the Contract. Documents may be submitted in either official language. NOTE: Task-Based Informatics Professional Services (TBIPS) Method of Supply is refreshed three (3) times per year. title: Design & Construction of the New Accommodations Buildings
description: DEFENCE CONSTRUCTION CANADA (DCC) is requesting Proposals from Design-Build Teams to design and construct the new accommodations buildings at CFB Kingston following a modified design-build approach. The scope of this project is to construct four (4) new accommodations buildings. The initial phase will consist of two (2) buildings with the potential of adding two (2) more buildings subject to approvals. Each building will each consist of a minimum 72 category II rooms in accordance with the DND Living Accommodations with a maximum of six (6) storeys. The scope of work will also include improvements to water, storm, sanitary, power, and telecommunications. A new access road will be required to reach and service these buildings as well as parking. Additional details are provided in the Request for Proposals (RFP) documents. The estimated cost for this opportunity is in the range of $37,600,000 for the two (2) buildings. The overall construction estimate for all four (4) buildings is estimated at $75,200,000. A site visit has been arranged for the following date, time, and location. It is highly recommended that bidders attend this visit. Date: August 27, 2026 Time: 10:00 AM (local time) Location: 3 Radar Street – East Parking Lot, Kingston, ON Firms that consider themselves qualified to provide these services are invited to submit their proposals through the MERX Electronic Bidding System on or before the closing date and time indicated on the Electronic Bidding System. This solicitation is being conducted in accordance with the requirements set out in the Canadian Free Trade Agreement (CFTA), Chapter Nineteen of the Canada-European Union Comprehensive Economic and Trade Agreement (CETA) and the World Trade Organization Agreement on Government Procurement (WTO-GPA). title: Germany – Planting and maintenance services of green areas – Unterhaltspflege Elbauenpark Magdeburg in 3 Losen
description: Es ist beabsichtigt, die Pflegeleistungen für den Elbauenpark in Magdeburg für einen Zeitraum von einem Jahr (Anlage Plan) unterschiedlicher Größe und unterschiedlichen Leistungsumfanges zu vergeben. Der Auftragnehmer erhält die Option einer Verlängerung des Vertrages um jeweils ein weiteres Jahr bis zu einer Gesamtlaufzeit von maximal 4 Jahren. Der Vertrag verlängert sich jeweils um ein weiteres Jahr, wenn er nicht mit einer Frist von mindestens 12 Wochen zum Ablauf des jeweiligen Vertragsjahres schriftlich gekündigt wird; einer Begründung bedarf es nicht. Einzelheiten der Verlängerungsoption regeln der Bekanntmachungstext und der Vertragsentwurf. Für die Vergütung wird eine Lohnpreisgleitklausel vereinbart; Erhöhungen von Tariflöhnen und gesetzlichem Mindestlohn werden entsprechend berücksichtigt. Es wird ausdrücklich darauf hingewiesen, dass für alle in diesem Leistungsverzeichnis aufgeführten Arbeiten die Beschäftigung von Subunternehmen ausgeschlossen ist (Ausnahme Baumpflege und Inspektion und Wartungskontrolle Spiel - und Sportgeräte nach DIN EN 1176). Vor Kalkulation und Abgabe eines Angebotes wird auf die unbedingt hierfür erforderliche Begehung und Begutachtung des Pflegeobjektes hingewiesen, um sich über die örtlichen Gegebenheiten entsprechend umfassend und ausreichend zu informieren. Nachforderungen die auf Unkenntnis der grundlegenden Situation vor Ort basieren, werden nicht berücksichtigt und zurückgewiesen. Die Arbeiten erfordern Einsatz, Präsenz und Leistungsbereitschaft der Firmen vor Ort (Montag bis Freitag, s. Ausführungen). Die Vorgaben der DIN 18 919 sind Grundlage der Pflegearbeiten im Elbauenpark und werden im Folgenden präzisiert. Für den Bereich des Kleinen Cracauer Angers wurde 2014 ein Pflegehandbuch erstellt. Der Große Cracauer Anger besteht aus 14 einzelnen Pflegebereichen, nach denen die Einteilung der einzelnen Pflegeleistungen und der anteiligen Mengen und Flächen ermittelt wurden. Die Beschreibung der Pflegeleistungen dient als fachtechnischen Pflegegrundlage. Die dargestellten Pflegeintervalle sind ausschließlich Regelannahmen. Das Pflegehandbuch kann in der Verwaltung des Elbauenparks eingesehen werden.

This Notice announces that the Department of Veterans Affairs, Consolidated Mail Outpatient Pharmacy (CMOP), Station 764, located in Murfreesboro, Tennessee, is proposing to negotiate a firm-fixed-price contract with Quality Manufacturing Systems, Inc. (QMSI), a small business, on a sole-source basis, under the authority at 41 U.S.C. 3304(a)(1) as implemented by RFO 6.103-1 (Only One Responsible Source). The proposed action is for the modification of the existing tote conveyance and Automated Pharmacy Fulfillment System (APFS) at Mid-South CMOP. The modification will add semi-automated packer (SAP) capability to the existing tote line, including conversion of Labeling Spurs 9 and 10 into Pharmacist Verification (PV) spurs, conversion of PV Spurs 3 and 4 into manual packing stations, integration of three package takeaway conveyors, tote sorter and diagnostic screen updates, and installation of the associated control system hardware and software. The work also requires modification of station workload-balancing logic, additional infrastructure to support the new SAP station (including a pharmacy Ethernet drop and supporting utilities), and development of a Human-Machine Interface (HMI) application enabling independent operator control of puck conveyance separate from tote Hytrol conveyor operations. The APFS is designed using proprietary software developed by QMSI, including the semi-automated packing machine software, product routing, and machine interface software. This software cannot be modified by any entity other than QMSI. QMSI is the only vendor with full knowledge of the overall system design, workload allocation logic, and the interaction between the tote conveyance, PLC/HMI controls, and APFS subsystems. Basis for Lack of Competition: Competition is not being sought because QMSI is the sole source possessing the proprietary knowledge, technical capability, and authorized access necessary to modify, integrate, validate, and warrant the existing QMSI-proprietary software, controls, and APFS integration at this facility. This determination is documented in the Government's market research report and single-source justification for Acquisition Plan 36C770-26-AP-0637. Invitation to Respond: Any firm believing it possesses the proprietary authorization and technical capability to perform the required software integration, controls modification, and APFS-compatible work described above is invited to submit a written capability statement demonstrating such ability. Capability statements must be received no later than 09/29/2026 and submitted via email to Michael.McAlhaney@va.gov. Any capability statement received will be considered by the Government in determining whether to proceed with the intended sole-source award to QMSI. This is not a request for quotes. Interested parties may also notify NCO 15 of their ability to provide similar upgrades for future needs.

description: Předmětem veřejné zakázky je kompletní dodávka technologie na klíč formou Design & Build, zahrnující inženýring, návrh technického řešení, výrobu, dodání, montáž, zkoušky a uvedení celého díla do provozu spočívající v dodávce 1 ks nového kompresoru, technologie úpravy a sušení stlačeného vzduchu s možností 100% redundance, VZT, 1 ks transformátoru 6,3/0,4 kV a veškerých souvisejících rozvodů vody, stlačeného vzduchu, elektroinstalace a MaR vč. nezbytných stavebních úprav a úprav stávajících rozvodů v kompresorovně. Zadavatel upozorňuje na to, že během jednání o předběžných nabídkách může dojít k upřesnění požadavku na výkon kompresorové stanice, pročež může dojít k rozšíření požadovaného předmětu plnění veřejné zakázky. Uvedené zohlední účastníci ve svých předběžných nabídkách (viz odst. 10.4 zadávací dokumentace). V rámci finalizace zadávacích podmínek (po jednací fázi) bude ze strany zadavatele předmět plnění veřejné zakázky v tomto ohledu stanoven pevně, a to s ohledem na jeho aktuální provozní potřeby a rovněž s přihlédnutím k dotčené části předběžných nabídek účastníků a k navazující jednací fázi zadávacího řízení. Podrobné vymezení předmětu veřejné zakázky, včetně technických podmínek, je uvedeno v přílohách zadávací dokumentace.

title: Ireland – Roadworks – DCC Contract for Construction of the Coolock to Clontarf Active Travel Scheme Section 2 – Gracefield Road to Vernon Avenue
description: Dublin City Council aims to enhance the quality of life for its residents by developing an integrated Active Travel Network. This comprehensive network is designed to foster connections among individuals via pedestrian pathways, segregated cycle provision and other environmentally friendly transportation alternatives. The enhancement of accessibility and interconnectivity for people walking, wheeling and cycling within this network is anticipated to play a pivotal role in mitigating carbon emissions originating from transport activities. The Council’s objective is to augment the existing 40km network into a seamlessly connected 314km network spanning the entire city. The Gracefield Road to Vernon Avenue Active Travel Scheme is one of the projects identified under this initiative. Gracefield Road, Brookwood Avenue, Sybil Hill Road and Vernon Avenue have been identified as suitable roads for active travel measures. This scheme will deliver protected cycling facilities in both directions and numerous improvements for pedestrians over a 2.6km route along these roads, between the junctions with Malahide Road and Seafield Road. The scheme includes the provision of segregated cycle facilities, improved pedestrian facilities (footpath and junction upgrades), ducting, resurfacing, etc.. The scheme also includes the upgrade of seven signal-controlled junctions to improve pedestrian and cyclist facilities. The scheme comprises the following: - Reconfiguration of existing carriageway for inclusion of protected cycle lanes - Site clearance - Pavement works - Kerbs and footways - Traffic islands - Public lighting - Traffic signs and road markings - Drainage works - Traffic signals and ducting - Utilities - Landscaping and urban realm works - Bike stands - Temporary traffic management. For further information, please refer to documentation available to download from www.etenders.gov.ie; CfT ID 8916766. Please note that this project is subject to funding.

title: Repair collision damage to 2023 Dodge Durango Pursuit
description: This requirement is for repairing body damage and to perform necessary mechanical repairs on a 2023 Dodge Durango Pursuit (Tag number G62-6665Z, VIN# 1C4RDJFG3PC573974). The damage is due to Traffic Accident. Description of work includes Repair of all body damage to the vehicle body, frame, lights and structural components. title: Radiographic Testing (RT) of a large aluminum weldment
description: SOURCES SOUGHT/REQUEST FOR INFORMATION FOR Radiographic Testing (RT) of a large aluminum weldment for Letterkenny Army Depot (LEAD) The Army Contracting Command, Redstone Arsenal � Letterkenny Army Depot (ACC-RSA-LEAD) is issuing this Request for Information (RFI) and Source Sought announcement to gain information from industry and seek sources capable of and interested in providing radiographic testing (RT) of a large aluminum weldment, approximately 14x11x4 FT and thickness of weld joints 1.5-2.0� (more in some locations). All services will be expected to be performed at LEAD. Service provider will be expected to travel to LEAD within 24 hours notice to perform RT operations. Requirements could range in service timeline required and could be subject to daily needs or perhaps months-long gaps in service. Requirements will be expected to meet list of standards provided. Servicer will be responsible for bringing all required equipment for operation from taking images to evaluating them on-site. Methodology whether film, computer, or digital is permitted and subject to contractor discretion and shot requirements. There will often be real-time need for results with asset production and welding being on-hold until RT is completed. Current production outlook is 18 cabs / units in total. 3 cabs will require 100% RT in compliance with print 12940852 E Redline to include all ~230 shots per cab, even those struck out by the redlines. The other 15 cabs will require RT in compliance with 12940852 E Redline as it is written, ~ 37 shots required per cab. There are provisions in the 12940852 print for sampling plans and rework outcomes which would require additional shots to be taken on failed cab and those that follow. The overall project is expected to span late 2026 through 2031. The purpose of providing this information is to conduct Market Research and identify interested sources capable of inspecting these items. The following prints and standards apply to this requirement: 12472301 12553209 12940852 E Redline ASTM E1742 ASTM E1032 Mil Std 1895B Mil Std 2035A Mil Std 3057 Mil Std 370A The drawings for this requirement is export controlled, Distribution D, which contains unclassified sensitive military data. Only vendors who have a current DD Form 2345 � Military Critical Technical Data Agreement on file with Defense Logistics Information Service (DLIS), recent and acceptable NIST rating and Current DoW contracts are authorized to receive the drawing. Interested vendor(s) may request a copy of the applicable drawing via e-mail. Please contact Mr. Thomas Hall at Thomas.c.hall111.civ@army.mil. Contractors must be properly registered in the Government System for Award Management database (SAM). Offerors may obtain information on SAM registration and annual confirmation requirements by calling 1-866-606-8220, or via the Internet at www.sam.gov. Eligibility At this point, the Government requests the response from all interested capable businesses and the applicable NAICS for this requirement is 541380 � Testing Laboratories and Services with a small business size standard of $19 Million. At this time, the Government has made no decisions about whether a full and open competition will occur. Upon receipt of all responses to this notice, the Government will determine its path forward. Capabilities Statement and additional Information and Submission Details REQUESTED INFORMATION: Please provide a Capabilities Statement, which must address the following items: Company Information: Please provide your Company Name, CAGE Code, UEI Number, and physical address of your primary facility. Socioeconomic Status: Based on NAICS Code 541380 (Testing Laboratories and Services), what is your business size? Please list all applicable socioeconomic categories (e.g., Small Business, WOSB, SDVOSB, HUBZone, 8(a)). System for Award Management: Is your company currently registered and active in SAM.gov? Manufacturer vs. Distributor: For this specific requirement, will your company be the Manufacturer of the radiographic testing, or will you be acting as a distributor/dealer supplying the end-item of another manufacturer? Corporate Experience & Capability 5. Company Experience: Describe your company's experience over the last five years in performing radiographic testing (RT) on large aluminum weldments, particularly for military or aerospace applications. Please provide at least two examples of similar projects, including the scope, duration, and customer. 6. On-Site Operations: Detail your experience in setting up and conducting RT operations at a client's facility, specifically at a government or military installation like an Army Depot. 7. Turnaround Time: The requirement states a need for real-time results as asset production will be on hold. Describe your standard process for providing on-site image evaluation and delivering immediate results to production personnel. What is your typical turnaround time from image capture to providing a pass/fail determination? Personnel Qualifications 8. Certifications: Confirm that all personnel who will perform and interpret radiographic tests are certified in accordance with MIL-STD-3057, ASNT CP-189, or NAS410. Please specify which certification(s) your personnel hold and their certification levels (e.g., NDT Level II, Level III). 9. Inspector Experience: Provide details on the qualifications and years of experience of the NDT Level II or Level III inspectors who would be assigned to this project. Specifically, detail their experience with interpreting radiographs of aluminum welds according to military standards like MIL-STD-2035A and MIL-STD-1895. Technical Approach & Equipment 10. RT Methodology: The requirement permits film, computed, or digital radiography. Which method(s) does your company specialize in? Describe the advantages of your proposed methodology for this specific application (large aluminum structure, variable shot requirements). 11. Equipment: Provide a comprehensive list of the equipment you would bring on-site to perform all required tasks, from image capture to on-site evaluation. Include details on the radiation source (X-ray/Gamma-ray), imaging plates/film, processing/scanning equipment, and viewing/evaluation software and hardware. 12. Standards Compliance: Confirm your capability and standard procedures for performing RT in accordance with the following standards: MIL-STD-3057 (Arc Welding of Armor Grade Aluminum) MIL-STD-1895 (Radiographic Procedures for Partial-Penetration Aluminum Welds) MIL-STD-2035A (Nondestructive Testing Acceptance Criteria) ASTM E1742 (Standard Practice for Radiographic Examination) ASTM E1032 (Standard Practice for Radiographic Examination of Weldments Using Film) 13. Shot Execution Plan: Describe your approach to performing the high volume of shots required (approximately 230 shots for the first 3 cabs and 37 for the remaining 15), including how you would manage location marking, setup efficiency, and ensuring full coverage as per print 12940852. Operational & Logistical Capability 14. Rapid Deployment: The government requires service providers to be on-site at Letterkenny Army Depot (LEAD) within 24 hours of notification. Describe your logistical plan to meet this rapid deployment requirement, including personnel and equipment mobilization. 15. Scheduling Flexibility: This project involves an inconsistent workload, with potential for daily needs followed by months-long gaps in service between 2026 and 2031. How would your company manage personnel and resource allocation to accommodate this unpredictable schedule while ensuring availability? 16. Safety Plan: Provide an overview of your company's Radiation Protection Program (RPP) and safety procedures for conducting RT operations on an active production floor, ensuring the safety of both your personnel and nearby government employees. title: CentralSquare Pro Cloud Software and Services
description: NASA�s Information Technology Procurement Office (ITPO) has a requirement for CentralSquare Pro Cloud software and services to support mission?critical Computer?Aided Dispatch (CAD) and Records Management System (RMS) operations for NASA Protective Services. The requirement includes cloud?based CAD dispatch positions, mobile CAD licenses, field operations modules, GIS mapping and AVL playback, GovCloud?hosted CAD and RMS environments, CLQ location services, SMS paging, API connectivity, and CrimeView analytics subscriptions for integrated crime?data analysis. Together, these components provide a unified, secure, AWS?hosted platform that enables real?time dispatching, mobile responder connectivity, NIBRS?compliant reporting, and data?driven situational awareness across all NASA centers. NASA/ITPO intends to issue a sole source contract to acquire the services from CentralSquare Technologies, LLC of 1000 Business Center Drive, Lake Mary, Florida 32746-5585 under the authority of FAR 6.103-1, only one responsible source and no other supplies or services will satisfy agency requirements. CentralSquare Technologies, LLC is the sole source provider for this requirement. The Government intends to acquire a commercial product or service using FAR Part 12. Interested organizations may submit their capabilities and qualifications to perform the effort electronically via email to caitlin.m.poulton@nasa.gov and sara.stuart@nasa.gov not later than 1:00 PM ET on September 29, 2026. Such capabilities/qualifications will be evaluated solely for the purpose of determining whether to conduct this acquisition on a competitive basis. A decision by the Government not to compete this acquisition on a full and open competition basis, based upon responses to this notice, is solely within the discretion of the Government.
